findings.location: “Oh, it was about half a mile to our closest neighbor, the Rhine’s place, and then about another quarter of a mile to the Brightbills,” replied Grandma.
findings.source_quote: “Oh, it was about half a mile to our closest neighbor, the Rhine’s place, and then about another quarter of a mile to the Brightbills,” replied Grandma.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the distances fully into Norwegian and remove the leftover English parenthetical. For example: «Åh, det var omtrent en halv mile til vår nærmeste nabo, Rhine-familien, og så omtrent en kvart mile til Brightbill-familien,» svarte bestemor. (If you prefer metric, render both consistently, e.g. «omtrent 0,8 km» and «omtrent 0,4 km», but keep the original meaning and relative proportions.)
findings.translation_quote: «Åh, det var omtrent en halv mile (half a mile) til vår nærmeste nabo, Rhine-familien, og så omtrent en kvart mile til Brightbill-familien,» svarte bestemor.

findings.source_quote: A brindle dog wearing a chain collar
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the English adjective 'brindle' into natural Norwegian. For example: alt="En tigrert hund med kjettinghalsbånd" or alt="En stripet (brindle) hund med kjettinghalsbånd" so the alt-tekst is fully in Bokmål and idiomatic.
findings.translation_quote: En brindle hund som har et kjettinghalsbånd
